title: ISO AMT Exposure Modeler
description: AMT liability from an ISO exercise spread using the 2026 exemption amounts and phase-out thresholds. Reports AMT owed, the effective (post-phase-out) exemption, the maximum shares exercisable without triggering AMT, and the AMT credit generated, plus a 5-step exercise-quantity scenario ladder. Port of Apex #109 (al_id AL-116).

shares.description: Shares to exercise this year. Apex control id 'shares', default 10000, min 1, max 10000000, step 100.

strike_price.description: Incentive stock option strike price in USD per share. Apex control id 'strikePrice', default 2.50, min 0.01, step 0.01.

fmv.description: Fair market value per share at exercise, USD. Apex control id 'fmv', default 18.00, min 0.01, step 0.01.

ordinary_income.description: Gross W-2 and other ordinary income for the year, USD, before the standard deduction (the node subtracts the 2026 deduction itself; assumes the standard deduction, itemized and other 63(b) deductions not modelled). Apex control id 'ordinaryIncome', default 175000, min 0, step 1000. Drives the regular-tax leg, computed on taxable income (IRC sec. 63(b)(1)).

other_amt_adjustments.description: Other AMT preference items (depreciation, percentage depletion, etc.), USD. Apex control id 'otherAMT', default 0, min 0, step 1000.

filing_status.description: Filing status. Apex control id 'filingStatus', default 'single' ('Single / MFS') or 'mfj' ('Married Filing Jointly'). Selects the exemption, phase-out threshold and regular-tax brackets.

mcp_tool_definition.name: estimate_iso_amt_exposure
mcp_tool_definition.description: AMT liability from an ISO exercise spread using the 2026 exemption amounts and phase-out thresholds (IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32; IRC 55-57; IRC 422). Regular tax is on taxable income, gross ordinary income minus the 2026 standard deduction; AMTI takes no deduction (IRC 56(b)(1)(D)); standard deduction assumed, itemizers not modelled. Reports AMT owed, effective exemption, max shares without AMT, and the AMT credit, plus a 5-step scenario ladder. Deterministic, client-side, zero PII.

shares.description: Shares to exercise this year. Integer, min 1, max 10000000.

strike_price.description: ISO strike price in USD per share; min 0.01.

fmv.description: Fair market value per share at exercise in USD; min 0.01.

ordinary_income.description: Gross W-2 and other ordinary income for the year in USD, before the standard deduction; min 0.

other_amt_adjustments.description: Other AMT preference items in USD; min 0. Optional; defaults to 0.

filing_status.description: Filing status: 'single' (Single / MFS) or 'mfj' (Married Filing Jointly).

output_schema.description: output_payload: shares_exercised, strike_price, fmv_at_exercise, ordinary_income (the gross input, echoed), other_amt_adjustments, filing_status, iso_spread, amti, effective_exemption, amt_base, tentative_minimum_tax, standard_deduction (2026 amount by filing status, Rev. Proc. 2025-32 sec. 4.14(1)), taxable_income (max(0, ordinary_income - standard_deduction), the base of the regular tax per IRC sec. 63(b)(1)), regular_tax, amt_owed, amt_credit_generated, max_shares_no_amt, amt_triggered, scenarios[]{shares_exercised, iso_spread, amti, effective_exemption, amt_owed, net_value_after_amt, is_entered}.

input_schema_provenance: Top-level properties are exactly the policy_parameters members the kernel reads: shares, strike_price, fmv, ordinary_income, other_amt_adjustments, filing_status. Required set = the inputs unconditionally dereferenced by compute().
author: PostOakLabs
